precise_portfolio_independent_origin_cou: Three direct institutional streams support explicit source-level origin groups, while six streams are mixed-origin editorial/institutional collections and GDELT is a derived multi-origin index. The unresolved mixed-origin streams prevent a precise portfolio-wide independent-origin count. Publisher/domain/language counts remain non-substitutes.

records.publisher_identity: Official Council of the EU / European Council press platform managed by the General Secretariat of the Council
records.resolution_notes: The official site states that it serves two distinct EU institutions and its press stream also contains multiple entity/function labels. Direct institutional publication is established, but one single underlying institutional origin for the whole governed stream is not.

European Commission identifies Press Corner as press material from its Spokesperson's Service. This supports an institutional publication-origin group for source-network topology; it does not prove the truth of claims made in Commission material.
The governed source is the European Parliament's official press-release surface. Institutional publication origin is explicit; statement/event verification remains governed separately by P13.

GDELT describes itself as a platform/database built from hundreds of thousands of broadcast, print and online news sources. It is discovery/index evidence, not an independent underlying origin for indexed reporting.

Habertürk's masthead explicitly identifies the publisher. A general national-news stream can contain staff reporting, external statements, agency/cited material and other derivation patterns; publisher identity alone does not establish one underlying origin.

Meduza identifies its publisher/editorial organization and states that its stories are reported and written by journalists. The stream still mixes original reporting, sourced reporting, analysis and cited material, so one source-level underlying-origin group is not assigned.

records.publisher_identity: Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE)
records.resolution_notes: The governed path is an official OSCE news stream. OSCE is treated as the source-network institutional origin group; statements by OSCE remain statement evidence and do not automatically prove underlying events.

RMF24 describes itself as the RMF FM news portal created by station journalists, reporters and correspondents. The broad news stream still requires item-level provenance to distinguish original reporting, statements, citations and possible syndicated material.

The GOV.UK news-and-communications stream aggregates publications from many departments, agencies, ministers and official roles. It is a direct official platform but not one single underlying institutional origin group.

Ukrainska Pravda's reuse rules identify the publication and authors as rights holders unless otherwise indicated. A broad editorial news feed still requires item-level provenance before assigning an underlying-origin group or independence credit.
